issues.detail: Examples ignore error handling (no status-code checks, no raise_for_status, no handling of 401/429 or empty data), and 429 backoff is mentioned only in prose without a concrete retry procedure.

scenarios.name: unusual-flow-alerts-tsla-script
scenarios.rationale: B matches the rubric: correct endpoint, Bearer token from UNUSUAL_WHALES_API_TOKEN, UW-CLIENT-API-ID header, and params ticker_symbol, min_premium=100000, is_otm and size_greater_oi. A uses the right endpoint but reads UW_API_TOKEN, omits the UW-CLIENT-API-ID header, and uses all_opening instead of size_greater_oi.

scenarios.name: avoid-hallucinated-endpoint-options-flow
scenarios.rationale: A covers every rubric element (GET, /api/option-trades/flow-alerts, Bearer header from UNUSUAL_WHALES_API_TOKEN, UW-CLIENT-API-ID header, and why the original URL, method and query-param auth are invalid), while B gets the endpoint, method and Bearer header right but uses the wrong env var name (UW_API_TOKEN) and omits the UW-CLIENT-API-ID header, and hedges about the original URL.
